audits.subject: Chemistry
fragmentationNotes: 'Equilibrium' (2: Kp/Kc relation, Reaction Quotient) and 'Ionic Equilibrium' (11) are both fragments of the single NCERT chapter 'Equilibrium'. 'Equilibrium' here is purely the gaseous Chemical-Equilibrium half (Kp/Kc, Q) and 'Ionic Equilibrium' is the acid-base/Ksp half. Should be one navigable chapter; the gaseous-equilibrium half is the reviewer-flagged 'only 1 formula' (effectively 2) gap.

'Atomic Structure' (11) and 'Periodic Properties' (2) are NCERT Class 11 'Structure of Atom' and 'Classification of Elements & Periodicity' respectively — distinct NCERT chapters, so this is acceptable, NOT fragmentation. Listed here only to confirm they were checked.

Organic chemistry is split across many topic strings (GOC, Reaction Mechanisms, Isomerism, Organic Reagents, Practical Organic Chem, Hydrocarbons, Haloalkanes, Alcohols Phenols, Aldehydes & Ketones, Carboxylic Acids, Amines, Biomolecules, Polymers, Everyday Life). Most map cleanly to canonical chapters, but 'Organic Reagents', 'Reaction Mechanisms' and 'GOC' are cross-cutting buckets, not NCERT chapters — their reagent/mechanism content is genuinely chapter-spanning so the split is defensible for a revision app, but 'Isomerism' content (stereochemistry) overlaps GOC/Haloalkanes and could be consolidated under a single Stereochemistry/GOC chapter.

'Analytical Chem' (3: flame colors, Mohr's salt, potash alum formulas) and 'Qualitative Analysis' (26) both cover inorganic salt analysis / practical inorganic; the 3 'Analytical Chem' items belong inside 'Qualitative Analysis' / Practical chapters. Minor fragmentation.

'd-Block Elements' (5) and 'Coordination Compounds' (13) are separate canonical chapters (correct), but the d-block magnetic-moment / KMnO4 / dichromate items overlap conceptually with coordination chemistry — acceptable split.
orphanTopics: GOC — non-standard bucket name (General Organic Chemistry); valid revision grouping but not an NCERT chapter title; better labelled 'Basic Principles of Organic Chemistry / GOC'.
Organic Reagents — cross-cutting reagent dictionary, not a syllabus chapter; fine as an index but mis-named relative to canonical chapters.
Reaction Mechanisms — cross-cutting bucket, not an NCERT chapter; its SN1/SN2/E1/E2/EAS content properly belongs to Haloalkanes / Hydrocarbons / GOC.
Practical Organic Chem — maps to NCERT 'Organic Chemistry: Some Basic Principles & Techniques' (purification/detection/estimation) plus practical tests; non-standard short name.
Analytical Chem — vague 3-item bucket; content is inorganic salt formulas/flame tests that belong under Qualitative Analysis / Practical Chemistry.
Everyday Life — short for 'Chemistry in Everyday Life' (NCERT Class 12 chapter); acceptable but abbreviated.

Equilibrium — mis-leading name: contains ONLY chemical (gaseous) equilibrium while the chapter's ionic half lives under 'Ionic Equilibrium'; should be renamed 'Chemical Equilibrium' and ideally merged.

12 entries but duplicated (orthogonality, radical axis, tangency line repeated) ~ 9 unique. Missing: standard/center-radius forms explicitly, equation of tangent in slope form, pair of tangents (SS1=T^2), chord of contact, chord bisected at point (T=S1), family of circles (S+lambda L, S+lambda S'), angle of intersection, position of point, common tangents count, radical center.

Split across Conic Sections (tangent/normal slope & parametric, latus rectum, chord of contact) and a 1-item Parabola topic (reflection). Missing as single revision unit: standard forms & key elements (focus, directrix, vertex, LR=4a), parametric point (at^2,2at), tangent/normal at point form, condition of tangency c=a/m, focal chord & focal distance, point of intersection of tangents, properties (tangent at vertex, sub-normal=2a). Needs consolidation into one Parabola chapter.

Split: Conic Sections holds standard eqn, tangent slope/parametric, normal, director circle, auxiliary circle, latus rectum; Ellipse topic only has reflection. Missing consolidated: eccentricity & b^2=a^2(1-e^2), foci/directrices, focal distance property (SP+S'P=2a), chord of contact & midpoint chord, condition of tangency c^2=a^2m^2+b^2, eccentric angle, position of point. Fragmented.

Well covered across Conic Sections (standard eqn, tangent, director circle, rectangular xy=c^2 tangent/normal/LR) + Hyperbola topic (asymptotes, angle, conjugate relation, rect parametric). Minor gaps: focal distance |SP-S'P|=2a, eccentricity e^2=1+b^2/a^2, conjugate hyperbola eccentricity relation 1/e^2+1/e'^2=1, condition of tangency c^2=a^2m^2-b^2. Still fragmented across two topics.

Reviewer-flagged. Has standard limits (sin/tan/log/exp/algebraic), 1^inf form, Maclaurin e^x/sinx/cosx, log expansion. Missing for full revision: list of indeterminate forms, (a^x-1)/x, (1+x)^{1/x}->e, sandwich theorem statement, limit of [x]/{x}, L'Hopital quick form, expansion of (1+x)^n & tan/sin series, standard trig-substitution limits. Reviewer says Limits needs strengthening.

Reviewer-flagged as 'not clear'. Continuity has ONLY 1 formula (condition for continuity); Differentiation has 11 but skewed to theorems (Rolle, LMVT dup, L'Hopital). Missing: full standard derivatives table (x^n, e^x, a^x, ln x, trig, inverse-trig), differentiability definition & relation to continuity, types of discontinuity, derivative of |x| & [x], implicit differentiation, derivative of inverse-trig combos, higher-order derivatives, derivative from first principles, Cauchy MVT. Continuity is the weakest sub-area; consolidate Continuity+Differentiation+(Differentiability).

Good base (tangent/normal slope, increasing/decreasing, rate measure, angle of intersection, approximation, subtangent/subnormal, critical point, 2nd derivative test). Missing: equation of tangent & normal at point, length of tangent/normal, maxima-minima first-derivative test, global max/min on interval, point of inflection, concavity, monotonicity in interval, errors & relative/percentage error, Rolle/MVT geometric application. Topic name 'AOD' is a non-standard abbreviation.

Split between 'Indefinite Integration' (sqrt forms, ln x, by parts via e^x(f+f')) and a generic 'Integration' topic (by parts, standard 1/(x^2-a^2), Leibniz, e^x(f+f')). Missing standard integral table: x^n, 1/x, e^x, a^x, sin/cos/sec^2/cosec^2, tan/cot/sec/cosec, 1/(a^2+x^2)->arctan, 1/sqrt(a^2-x^2)->arcsin, 1/sqrt(x^2±a^2)->log, partial fractions, linear/quadratic in denominator (px+q)/(ax^2+bx+c), trig substitution standard set, integration of sin^m cos^n. Fragmented with the 'Integration' grab-bag.

Definite Integration (limit-of-sum, Wallis dup, King/Queen property, log-sin dup, Gamma) + King's rule & Leibniz from 'Integration' + 1-item Area Under Curve. Missing: fundamental theorem of calculus, all standard definite-integral properties (even/odd, periodic, a->b reversal, 0->2a split), area between two curves, area bounded by curve & axis, area in parametric/polar, estimation/comparison properties. Heavily fragmented across 3 topics; Area Under Curve nearly empty.

Has linear DE (IF), Bernoulli, homogeneous, Newton cooling, orthogonal trajectory. Missing: order & degree, variable separable form, reducible to homogeneous, exact equations, formation of DE by elimination, general vs particular solution, IF for linear in x, standard growth/decay model, solution of dy/dx=f(ax+by+c).

Strong on adjoint/inverse properties (adj of adj, det adj, A.adjA=|A|I, inverse reversal, Cayley-Hamilton, orthogonal, skew-symmetric det, trace). Missing: definition/order of matrix operations, (AB)^T & (AB)^{-1} laws (transpose reversal present), symmetric/skew decomposition A=(A+A')/2+..., idempotent/nilpotent/involutory definitions, properties of trace tr(AB)=tr(BA), elementary row operations & inverse by them, solving AX=B via matrix inverse.

Has area of triangle, Cramer (3 consistency cases), factor theorem. Missing: expansion/properties of determinants (row/column ops, scalar multiple |kA|=k^n|A|, |AB|=|A||B|, |A^T|=|A|), minors & cofactors, determinant of triangular/diagonal, condition for collinearity, system consistency summary (homogeneous nontrivial when |A|=0), differentiation of determinant (present under Differentiation, mislocated).

Vector Algebra (magnitude, dot, projection, cross, unit, STP, VTP, Lagrange, angle bisector) + Vectors topic (volume tetrahedron, VTP expansion, Lagrange dup, reciprocal system, vector area triangle dup, linear dependence). Note 'Vectors' topic ALSO contains 3D-geometry items (sphere, plane-through-origin loci) that belong in 3D. Missing here: section formula (internal/external), collinearity & coplanarity conditions, components & direction ratios, angle between vectors via dot, area of parallelogram, condition for perpendicular/parallel, [a b c]^2 Gram. Fragmented Vectors<->Vector Algebra.

Largest topic (29) but ~40% duplicates: Equation of Line (vector/cartesian), Plane normal/intercept forms, distance point-plane, angle between planes, shortest distance skew lines, family of planes all appear TWICE. Plus 'Vectors' topic leaks 3D content (sphere, loci/planes). De-duplicated unique ~18 covering DCs/DRs, line & plane forms, skew distance, image/foot of perpendicular, coplanarity, bisector planes. Only 5 (addition theorem, conditional, Bayes, binomial distribution, variance binomial). Missing: classical definition P=fav/total, multiplication theorem & independence, total probability theorem, complement, odds for/against, mean/variance of binomial (mean present?), at-least-one probability, mutually exclusive vs independent, random variable & expectation E(X), Poisson (low), geometric probability.

Has variance, combined mean, combined variance, coefficient of variation. Missing: mean (mean/median/mode) formulas, relation mode=3median-2mean, standard deviation definition & shortcut formula SD=sqrt(Sigma x^2/n - mean^2), mean deviation about mean/median, variance of first n naturals, effect of change of scale/origin on mean & variance.

Only 2 unique (2tan^-1 x conversion, sum formula for tan^-1) padded to 3. audits.subject: Biology

chapters.gapNotes: Has taxonomic hierarchy, binomial nomenclature, taxonomic aids, properties of life. Thin on: nomenclature rules (ICBN/ICZN), taxonomical categories full ladder with examples, diversity numbers. Adequate for low-yield chapter.

Has Five Kingdom, viruses/viroids, bacteriophage, Fungi groups, Protozoa. Missing high-yield: Monera/bacteria classification (eubacteria, archaebacteria, cyanobacteria), Protista groups full (dinoflagellates, euglenoids, slime moulds), nutritional modes table, lichens, mycorrhiza, Whittaker's criteria table, prions. Borderline thin for a top-yield chapter.

Has life cycles, algae classification, bryophytes, pteridophytes. Missing: gymnosperms features, angiosperm life cycle detail, algae pigments/stored food/cell wall comparison table (Chloro/Phaeo/Rhodophyceae), alternation of generations (haplontic/diplontic/haplo-diplontic), classes of pteridophytes. High-yield NEET chapter, under-covered.

Excellent coverage: all major phyla Porifera through Chordata + vertebrate classes + basis-of-classification features. One of the strongest chapters. Could add a single consolidated basis-of-classification (symmetry/coelom/segmentation) recall card but effectively complete.

Strong: root/stem/leaf modifications, aestivation, placentation, inflorescence, floral formula/symmetry, fruit types, seed, 3 families (Solanaceae, Fabaceae, Liliaceae). Complete for NEET morphology recall.

Combined 7 (xylem/phloem, vascular bundles, secondary growth root & dicot stem, leaf types, bulliform, simple tissues). Missing: meristem types/classification, complex permanent tissues detail, monocot vs dicot stem/root/leaf full anatomy table, periderm/cork cambium, annual rings, tissue system (epidermal/ground/vascular). NOTE: split across two topic names = fragmentation.

Has epithelial tissue, cockroach excretion/vision, frog anatomy. Missing high-yield: connective tissue types table, muscle tissue types, neural tissue, cockroach full digestive/circulatory/nervous systems, frog systems comparison. Animal tissues table is a frequent NEET item and is thin.

Combined 11 across two topics (mitochondria, chloroplast, fluid mosaic, nucleus, Golgi, ribosomes, cilia/flagella, cytoskeleton, prokaryotic envelope, endomembrane system). Missing: cell theory, prokaryote vs eukaryote comparison table, ER (rough/smooth), lysosome, vacuole, centrosome/centriole 9+0, microbodies. NOTE: 'Cell Structure' + 'Cell Unit of Life' = same canonical chapter split = fragmentation.

Has enzyme inhibition, DNA bonds, Michaelis-Menten, lipid/protein structure, co-factors. Missing high-yield: classification of carbohydrates/proteins/lipids, amino acid types & essential AAs, primary metabolites vs secondary, nucleotide vs nucleoside, enzyme classification (6 classes), factors affecting enzyme activity, polysaccharides (cellulose/starch/glycogen/inulin). Under-covered for a high-yield chapter.

Strong: phases, prophase I substages, mitosis stages, checkpoints, anaphase I vs II, crossing over, significance of meiosis, meiosis II. Near complete; could add interphase (G1/S/G2) duration detail and mitosis vs meiosis comparison card.

Has water potential, stomatal apparatus, apoplast/symplast, cohesion-tension, guttation, imbibition, plasmolysis. Missing: diffusion vs osmosis vs active transport comparison, root pressure, transpiration types & significance, phloem loading/unloading (mass flow / pressure flow). NOTE: topic largely deleted from current NCERT but still NEET-relevant; reasonable coverage.

Has nitrogen cycle, root nodule formation, deficiency symptoms. Missing: macro vs micronutrients list, criteria of essentiality, mobile vs immobile elements, role of essential elements table, mechanism of biological nitrogen fixation (nitrogenase/leghaemoglobin), hydroponics. Thin-leaning.

Has Calvin cycle, C4 (Hatch-Slack), Z-scheme, Blackman's law, photorespiration, pigments. Missing high-yield: cyclic vs non-cyclic photophosphorylation comparison, C3 vs C4 vs CAM comparison table, chemiosmotic hypothesis (ATP synthase), light vs dark reaction net equation, red drop/Emerson effect, factors affecting rate. High-yield chapter, should reach 9.

Has glycolysis (EMP), Krebs/TCA, RQ, ETS. (Oxygen dissociation curve actually belongs to human Breathing.) Missing: net ATP yield calculation (38 vs 36), fermentation (alcoholic/lactic), aerobic vs anaerobic comparison, amphibolic pathway, oxidative phosphorylation summary, link reaction (pyruvate to acetyl-CoA). Solid core but missing the ATP-accounting items NEET loves.

Has sigmoid curve, hormones functions, photoperiodism, vernalization, absolute vs relative growth. Missing: 5 PGRs detailed (auxin/GA/cytokinin/ABA/ethylene) with discoverers & specific effects, differentiation/dedifferentiation/redifferentiation, growth phases (meristematic/elongation/maturation), seed dormancy, applications of PGRs. Good but extend hormone detail.

Has protein digestion, dental formula, liver/bile, absorption. Missing high-yield: digestive enzymes full table (mouth to ileum, substrate-enzyme-product), gastric/intestinal/pancreatic juice composition, alimentary canal layers, disorders (PEM, jaundice, indigestion), hormones (gastrin/secretin/CCK). Thin-leaning for a recall-heavy chapter.

Has lung volumes, capacities, regulation, gas transport. Missing: oxygen dissociation curve & Bohr effect (currently mis-filed under Respiration), CO2 transport forms (bicarbonate/carbamino), chloride shift, partial pressure values table (pO2/pCO2 alveoli/blood/tissue), respiratory disorders (asthma/emphysema/occupational). Should consolidate ODC here.

Has heart flow, ECG, blood groups, coagulation, cardiac cycle, lymph, disorders. Missing: blood composition (plasma proteins, formed elements counts), cardiac output/stroke volume values, double circulation, conducting system (SA/AV node/Purkinje), Rh incompatibility/erythroblastosis. Good high-yield base.

Has nephron, counter-current, haemodialysis, RAAS. Missing high-yield: urine formation steps (filtration/reabsorption/secretion) with values (GFR 125ml/min), ammonotelic/ureotelic/uricotelic comparison, juxtaglomerular apparatus, hormonal regulation (ADH/aldosterone/ANF), micturition, other excretory organs, disorders (uremia, nephritis). Thin for a high-yield chapter.

Has sarcomere, sliding filament, joints, 206 bones, muscular disorders. Missing: axial vs appendicular skeleton breakdown (numbers per region), red vs white muscle fibres comparison, types of movement (amoeboid/ciliary/muscular), pectoral & pelvic girdle detail, muscle protein detail (actin/myosin/troponin/tropomyosin), skeletal disorders (arthritis/osteoporosis/gout).

Has nerve impulse, synaptic transmission, photoreception, cochlea, brain structure, reflex arc, vestibular apparatus. Missing: resting vs action potential ionic mechanism (Na+/K+) with mV values, eye structure & accommodation, CNS/PNS/ANS organisation (sympathetic vs parasympathetic table), parts of neuron, all-or-none. Strong base for high-yield chapter.

Has thyroid, pancreas, adrenal, hormone action, PTH, pineal. Missing high-yield: hypothalamus-pituitary axis & all anterior/posterior pituitary hormones, GH disorders (gigantism/dwarfism/acromegaly), thyroid disorders (goitre/cretinism/Graves), diabetes I vs II, complete endocrine gland-hormone-function summary table, hormones of heart/kidney/GI tract. Should reach 10.

MISSING. Foundational reproduction chapter (asexual modes: binary fission, budding, fragmentation, spore formation; vegetative propagules; sexual phases pre/post-fertilisation; events in sexual reproduction; juvenile/reproductive/senescent phases; oestrous vs menstrual cycle). Low weight but a clean miss; some content folded into other repro topics but no dedicated recall card set.

THIN (3 only). Has double fertilization, embryo sac, pollination agents. Missing major high-yield: microsporogenesis vs megasporogenesis, anther/microsporangium structure (4 wall layers, tapetum), structure of mature pollen grain, ovule/megasporangium structure, embryo sac development (Polygonum 8-nucleate 7-celled), pollen-pistil interaction, endosperm development, apomixis & polyembryony, dicot vs monocot embryo. One of the highest-yield NEET chapters and badly under-covered.

Has menstrual cycle hormones, spermatogenesis vs oogenesis, embryonic development, sperm structure, follicular development, parturition, male system. Missing: female reproductive system detail, structure of ovary/Graafian follicle/corpus luteum, fertilisation & implantation steps, placenta structure & hormones (hCG/hPL), lactation, gametogenesis hormonal control (GnRH/FSH/LH). High-yield, push to 11.

Has ART, infertility treatments, contraceptives, MTP. Missing: contraceptive methods full classification (natural/barrier/IUD/oral/surgical) comparison, STDs list & causative agents, amniocentesis misuse, population/RCH programmes, infertility causes. Adequate.

Combined 14 across 'Principles of Inheritance' + 'Genetics' (Mendel laws via test cross, dihybrid, incomplete/co-dominance, linkage Morgan, sex determination, mutation, pedigree, polygenic, Mendelian & chromosomal disorders, colour blindness, thalassemia). Very strong. Missing: Mendel's laws stated explicitly (dominance/segregation/independent assortment), 9:3:3:1 & modified ratios card, multiple alleles. NOTE: 'Genetics' is a non-standard split of this chapter = fragmentation.

Excellent: DNA helix, central dogma, tRNA, replication fork, transcription unit, DNA fingerprinting, lac operon, genetic code, HGP, RNA types, nucleosome, post-transcriptional mods, DNA vs RNA. Missing only: Hershey-Chase/Griffith/Meselson-Stahl experiments card, translation initiation/elongation/termination detail. Near complete. NOTE: 'Lac Operon' also appears under 'Genetics' = duplicate/overlap.

Strong: homologous/analogous organs, Hardy-Weinberg factors & equation, Miller-Urey, adaptive radiation, human evolution, industrial melanism, origin-of-life theories, divergent/convergent, geological time scale. Missing only: Darwinism vs Lamarckism vs neo-Darwinism comparison, types of natural selection (stabilising/directional/disruptive), evidences of evolution consolidated (palaeontological/embryological/molecular). Excellent: antibody structure, HIV, immunity types, vaccination, malaria, cancer, bacterial/fungal/helminth diseases (ringworm, ascariasis, filariasis), drugs/alcohol, B vs T cells, innate barriers. Complete for NEET. Could add allergy/autoimmunity & disease-causative-agent master table but coverage is full.

Has biogas plant, sewage treatment, antibiotics, biocontrol, bioactive molecules. Missing: microbes in household products (curd/cheese/bread/beverages organisms table), industrial products (acids/enzymes/alcohol with organisms), microbes as biofertilisers (Rhizobium/Azotobacter/mycorrhiza/cyanobacteria), primary vs secondary sewage treatment detail. Combined with applications below this is the strongest cluster: PCR & applications, pBR322, EcoRI restriction site, gel electrophoresis, insulin maturation/recombinant insulin, bioreactor, Bt cotton, RNAi, GEAC ethics, ELISA, cloning vectors, transgenic animals, tissue culture. Missing distinct cards: gene therapy (ADA-SCID), molecular diagnostics summary, biopiracy/patents (Basmati/turmeric/neem), Flavr Savr/golden rice/pest-resistant plants table, GMO benefits & concerns. Strong: pyramids (number/biomass/energy), succession (xerarch), carbon vs phosphorus cycle, decomposition, stratification, food web vs chain. Missing: energy flow & 10% law / productivity (GPP/NPP/secondary), standing crop vs standing state, nutrient cycling types, ecosystem services. Just over complete threshold.

Has hotspots, species-area curve, in-situ vs ex-situ, Evil Quartet, in-situ conservation. Missing high-yield: levels of biodiversity (genetic/species/ecological), patterns (latitudinal gradients, species richness), rivet-popper hypothesis, importance of biodiversity, Red Data Book/IUCN categories, sacred groves, Ramsar/biosphere reserves/national parks numbers. Should reach 9.

Strong: biomagnification, ozone depletion & hole mechanism, greenhouse gases, eutrophication, solid waste, deforestation case studies, protocols. Missing: air pollution (electrostatic precipitator/scrubber, catalytic converter), water pollution & BOD, noise pollution, case studies consolidated. NOTE: chapter largely deleted from current NCERT but still NEET-tested; well covered.

fragmentationNotes: 'Cell Structure' (5) and 'Cell Unit of Life' (6) are the SAME canonical chapter 'Cell: The Unit of Life' split into two topics - merge for navigation.
'Anatomy of Plants' (6) and 'Anatomy of Flowering Plants' (1) are the same chapter split apart - the 1-formula topic should be absorbed into the main anatomy topic.

'Genetics' (5) is a non-standard split of 'Principles of Inheritance and Variation' (and overlaps Molecular Basis) - 'Lac Operon' appears in BOTH 'Genetics' and 'Molecular Basis' (duplicate). Consolidate genetics content under one canonical chapter.
'Biotechnology / Botany' (1, tissue culture) is a stray split of the Biotechnology cluster - merge into 'Biotechnology'.

The single 'Biotechnology' topic (14) actually conflates two distinct NCERT chapters - 'Principles & Processes' and 'and its Applications' - which inflates one topic and hides whether applications-specific items (gene therapy, GMOs, biopiracy) are covered.
orphanTopics: History of Biology (1) - 'Famous Scientists & Discoveries' is not an NCERT/NEET chapter; non-standard catch-all, better distributed into relevant chapters or kept as a meta/quick-fact card.
Biotechnology / Botany (1) - mis-named; content (tissue culture) belongs under Biotechnology: Principles and Processes.
Genetics (5) - non-standard chapter label; real NCERT chapter is 'Principles of Inheritance and Variation'.
Cell Structure (5) - duplicative/non-canonical label overlapping 'Cell: The Unit of Life'.

critic.verdict: The four audit matrices are largely sound and exhaustive on the canonical chapter lists for Physics, Chemistry and Math — no STANDARD chapter in those three subjects was omitted, and all six lokesh-flagged chapters were correctly flagged. Biology, however, has one clean miss: 'Strategies for Enhancement in Food Production' (NCERT Class 12) is never listed at all, not even as status='missing' — a genuine coverage hole on a NEET-tested chapter. Two softer gaps exist: Math's 'Heights and Distances' is folded into Properties of Triangles and never scored on its own, and Chemistry's quantitative/volumetric practical analysis is only implied via the orphan 'Analytical Chem' bucket. The agents' fragmentation and orphan-topic catalogues are accurate and consistent with what I re-derived (Waves split, AC/EMI split, Conics cluster, Integration cluster, Limits-Continuity-Differentiation cluster, Vectors-vs-Vector-Algebra leak, Cell/Anatomy/Genetics/Biotech splits). One scoring artefact to note: Physics EMI is given present=15 > target=12 (pct capped at 100), which reflects AC cards leaking into the EMI tally inside the bundled 'EMI & AC' topic rather than true over-coverage. The single prioritized gap list (35 ranked items) closes lokesh-flagged JEE-core chemistry first (Mole Concept 7%, Chemical Equilibrium 17%, both catastrophically thin), then flagged Elasticity, then the flagged Math calculus cluster (Continuity & Differentiability, Limits) and flagged Thermal Expansion, then the thinnest high-weight JEE-core chapters (Binomial 21%, Quadratics 38%, P&C 38%, Probability 36%, Kinetic Theory 36%), with the highest-yield NEET biology gap (Sexual Reproduction in Plants, 30%) and the missed food-production chapter slotted in lower because the flagging reviewer is a JEE aspirant. Recommended immediate action: rank 1-6 (the lokesh-flagged set) are the documented 4-to-5-star roadmap and should be closed before any new feature work.
